milestoneContract.title: V6 PKG-R3 first Phase0 attempt blockers fixed and trust root resealed
milestoneContract.objective: Fix the three Founder-approved blockers found by the first real target-machine Phase0 attempt (runtime-contracts fixture install-id leak, missing crypto import in install-report, builder permission mode that denied every edit) with the minimum protected changes, keep the builder limited to working-directory edits with shell, web, subagents and MCP denied, and reseal the trust root in the same commit so the next release ZIP is built from exactly this reviewed tree.
requirements: [V6-PKG-R3-PHASE0-FIXES-AND-RESEAL-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.rule] Üç protected düzeltmeyi onaylıyorum. Builder policy acceptEdits değişikliği yalnızca çalışma dizini içindeki edit/write işlemlerini kapsasın. Bash, web, alt ajan, MCP ve çalışma dizini dışına yazma yasak kalacak. Dry-run atlanmayacak. Bana çalıştıracağım exact komutu ver. Sonucu sana geri vereceğim. Ardından regression → Codex review → reseal → yeni ZIP sırasıyla devam et. [After the dry run] Dry-run kanıtını doğrula ve planlanan sırayla devam et: regression → reseal → commit → Codex independent review → new release ZIP. Yeni ZIP üretildiğinde önceki ZIP/signature artık geçersiz kabul edilsin ve yeni artifact yeniden imzaya gönderilsin. [PKG-R] reseal yetkisi: bu paket içinde maintainer-only generate-trust-root.mjs final reseal'ini çalıştırma yetkisi.

[V6-PKG-R3-PHASE0-FIXES-AND-RESEAL-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.protectedFiles] scripts/validate-runtime-contracts.mjs, scripts/install-report.mjs, config/builder-execution-policy.json, config/trust-root-manifest.json (regenerated by the unchanged generator), CANONICAL-STATUS.md

[V6-PKG-R3-PHASE0-FIXES-AND-RESEAL-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.constraint] Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; UNKNOWN, NOT_TESTED, BLOCKED or FAIL are never converted to PASS/CLEAN without real evidence; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11 in SEALED mode, including with UASCO_INSTALL_ID set as install.ps1 does, and the checkpoint records the measured validation environment.

validate-runtime-contracts.mjs isolates its temp fixture from the host UASCO_INSTALL_ID, restores it afterwards and asserts that an env/ledger mismatch still throws PHASE0_INSTALL_ID_ENV_LEDGER_MISMATCH; automation/lib/phase0-contract.mjs is unchanged.
install-report.mjs imports node:crypto and writes INSTALL_REPORT.json, and still fails on an install id mismatch.

config/builder-execution-policy.json changes only permissionMode from dontAsk to acceptEdits; allowedTools stay exactly Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep; Bash, WebFetch, WebSearch, NotebookEdit, Agent, Skill and mcp__* stay denied; the broker still passes --tools, --disallowedTools and --permission-mode with a dontAsk default; edits outside the working directory are not permitted.
config/trust-root-manifest.json is what the unchanged generator produces for the reviewed tree (SEALED, every protected file with its committed hash) and verify-trust-root passes on a clean checkout.

Current-truth documents keep the release-candidate values, record the failed first attempt and the superseded f0a4f0a ZIP and signature, and claim nothing beyond committed evidence; no other validator, script or policy changes.
mandatoryFailureCases: canonical validation failing when UASCO_INSTALL_ID is set
env/ledger install id mismatch no longer rejected
INSTALL_REPORT.json not written or install id mismatch accepted
builder able to use Bash, web, subagents, notebooks, skills or MCP
builder edits permitted outside the working directory
manifest not reproducible or failing verify-trust-root
